content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for District Panchayat Gariaband Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.gariaband.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Panchayat Gariaband recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the District Panchayat Gariaband recruitment is 16th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies announced by the District Panchayat Gariaband for the posts of Program Officer, Assistant Programmer, and Accountant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for all posts is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Chhattisgarh government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: For the Accountant post, candidates must have a B.Com degree with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST). For Bastar and Sarguja divisions, a second-class B.Com is acceptable.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a weightage on educational qualification, a computer practical exam, experience in government rural development schemes, and finally, a merit list will be prepared.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for District Panchayat Gariaband jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these posts is offline. Candidates need to send their duly filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Program Officer post?
faq.answer: The Program Officer post offers a salary as per Pay Level 10, with a specific monthly salary of 39875.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the District Panchayat Gariaband, located in Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of District Panchayat Gariaband, www.gariaband.gov.in. Direct links are provided in the Important Links section.
